name: jira-feed
description: SDD-agnostic spec-seed preparer — reads a JIRA ticket via the atlassian MCP, analyses the codebase via ia-framework MCP, researches docs via Context7, and formats a structured seed ready to hand off to any spec-driven framework's specify step (TLC, SpecKit, OpenSpec, ...). Optionally grills the seed for gray areas before handoff.
